basic_profile.bio: A passionate car enthusiast from Birmingham, Alabama, with a penchant for American muscle and sports cars. I work as a mechanical engineer and love to spend weekends at local car shows or cruising through the countryside in my Mustang. I'm happily married with two kids and often find myself tinkering in the garage after work. My Reddit activity spikes in the late evenings when the kids are asleep, and I get some time to unwind.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in mechanical engineering and have been working in the automotive industry for over a decade. I grew up in a family of gearheads, which fueled my passion for cars from a young age. Most of my knowledge comes from a mix of formal education and hands-on experience, both professionally and personally.
